author: Unknown
authorNote: The author is not named. Early guesses included Paul, Barnabas and Apollos; most scholars today think it was not Paul.
audience: Jewish Christians tempted to turn back
overview: Hebrews shows that Jesus is greater than angels, Moses and the priests, and that his once-for-all sacrifice fulfils the Old Testament system. It urges readers not to drift away, and gives a famous roll-call of faith (chapter 11).
storyPlace: A deep reflection on how the Old Testament points to Jesus.
